text: Before outreach, inspect the lead's actual business context and only then draft the message.
The website handoff must define proof, structure, and anti-template boundaries before implementation starts.
Comment drafting quality improved when post context research became mandatory instead of optional.
Meeting outcomes should preserve transcript evidence and scoring outputs inside the operational record.
Workspace setup became reliable only after environment creation was standardized into a repeatable onboarding flow.
Deterministic orchestration should remain explicit while AI is used only in bounded steps where it adds value.
Generation quality consistently improved after source review became a hard prerequisite.
Public demos must route only reviewed synthetic corpora and keep richer internal material isolated.
A premium technical website is easier to ship when proof, architecture, and content hierarchy are defined before build execution.
